taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Security validation under API version or schema fallback
controls.source_trace: Trace whether a fallback parses or defaults security-relevant fields differently from the policy validator, including missing/unknown versions.
controls.implementation_branch: Check where version negotiation occurs relative to authentication, canonicalization and validation. Defaults for absent fields can differ from explicit null or unknown enums. A supported legacy format is legitimate; the relevant result is whether the same forbidden operation reaches a protected consumer through a different decoder.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare the legitimate version with one supported fallback in an owned operation using harmless distinct markers and the same actor.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Multiple API versions are normal; a parser error or equivalent authorized behavior is not a bypass.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply the same invariant after canonicalization and test current, supported legacy and unsupported-version rejection.
